audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime third-party dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create, load, and manipulate workbooks and worksheets, including renaming, visibility control, and active sheet selection.
capabilities.title: Workbook and worksheet management

capabilities.text: Write and read string, numeric, boolean, date/time, and formula values through the `Cells` collection.
capabilities.title: Cell value and formula handling

capabilities.text: Apply full cell formatting including font, borders, fill, alignment, number format, and protection via `Style`.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Define data validation rules and apply conditional formatting to worksheet ranges using `Validation` and `FormatCondition`.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Embed images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP) and add drawing shapes with 38 preset geometries via `PictureCollection` and `ShapeCollection`.
capabilities.title: Embedded objects and shapes

capabilities.text: Create 18 chart types programmatically and preserve 7 ChartEx types loaded from existing workbooks; support Excel tables via `ListObjectCollection`.
capabilities.title: Charts and tables

limitations.text: Saving is currently limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and editing in pure Java without requiring Apache POI at runtime.
Provides a consistent API surface for cell values, styling, data validation, conditional formatting, and embedded objects.
Supports round-trip preservation of Excel features like merged cells, defined names, hyperlinks, comments, and charts.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source Java library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks, targeting Java 17 with no runtime dependencies.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Run `mvn package` to build and `mvn test` to execute the test suite located in `src/test/`.

workflows.name: Install dependency
workflows.text: Add the library via Maven using `mvn dependency:get -Dartifact=org.aspose:aspose-cells-foss:26.7.0`.

workflows.name: Release workflow
workflows.text: Releases publish to Maven Central using the workflow at `.github/workflows/maven-central-release.yml`.
